content.body:
Considered a light destroyer by the outbreak of WWII, these ships were very effective as Channel convoy escorts. Non-armored hulls and light displacement made them unsuitable for operations in the deeper and rougher North Sea, and in WWIIOL DD or Destroyer Escort is usually best employed in convoy with Transports taking tanks, trucks and troops across water on amphibious operations in the Channel Islands or when trying to invade across the English Channel. These light Destroyers were similar in size and armament to their German counterpart the Z34.
In game, the J-K class is currently represented by the Z34 Class Destroyer.
content.brief: TYPE: Destroyer CREW: 283 MAX SPEED: 36 knots WEIGHT: 1,811 tons ARMAMENT: 127 mm deck guns (5) 20 mm FlaK cannons (4) Twin 37 mm C30 batteries (2) 533 mm Torpedos (8)
